Messages.Author: Neil Paananen
Messages.Body:
Okay, some weird things started happening during tonight's game and I
thought I'd ask to see if any rules were written about it.

Constantin, Baro of the Caravan went and stole the Baleful Doll from
an Aabt Kindred. Later, he stole The Sargon Fragment from a different
Aabt. Later, Salbatore (controlled by the same meth.) attempted to
equip both The Sargon Fragment and the Baleful Doll off of Constantin.

1. Can Salbatore equip the Baleful Doll on the same turn as he didn't
have necromancy until he took the Sargon Fragment?

2. When a minion equips a piece of equipment anew, do all the effects
of the equipment go off? (I.e., can the meth choose a different vamp
to be affected by the Baleful Doll?)

I feel like this has been covered somewhere, but I can't find it.

Thanks!

Neil Paananen

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
"Neil Paananen" <paan...@ix.netcom.com> wrote in message
news:ebc4deaa.01100...@posting.google.com...

> Okay, some weird things started happening during tonight's game and I
> thought I'd ask to see if any rules were written about it.
>
> Constantin, Baro of the Caravan went and stole the Baleful Doll from
> an Aabt Kindred. Later, he stole The Sargon Fragment from a different
> Aabt. Later, Salbatore (controlled by the same meth.) attempted to
> equip both The Sargon Fragment and the Baleful Doll off of Constantin.
>
> 1. Can Salbatore equip the Baleful Doll on the same turn as he didn't
> have necromancy until he took the Sargon Fragment?

Once the Baleful Doll is in play any minion can hold it. The necromancy
requirement is only for bringing the card into play. Same thing as
retainers transfered via Heidelberg Castle.

> 2. When a minion equips a piece of equipment anew, do all the effects
> of the equipment go off? (I.e., can the meth choose a different vamp
> to be affected by the Baleful Doll?)

Nothing changes. All of the effects / targets of the equipment are set
when first brought into play, changing the minion with the equipment will
not have any effect.

Carpe noctem.
